name: print-social-plant-shop-posts-mint-with-vertical-leaf-plants-title
title: Plant shop pack on crinkled paper with mint panels, vertical 'Leaf Plants' titles and Roman numerals
whatItIs: Nine square posts on a crinkled white paper texture with pale mint panels, lush green leaf photos, dark green headlines ('How to take care of your indoor plants?'), a large vertical 'Leaf Plants' title, Roman numeral I/II tips and plant names (Monstera, Scindapsus, Parlour Palm).
whatItMeans: Fresh and gentle; paper texture and mint feel natural and hand-tended.
techniques: Use a crinkled paper texture as the base.
Run a large title vertically along a panel.
Let leaf photos bleed off edges.

vocabulary.definition: A scanned paper surface for tactility.
I, II, III used for numbering.
